from.place: proof step (a): translation invariance of the etale locus of a group homomorphism

title: Etale locus of a group homomorphism is translation invariant
statement: Let G and H be group schemes [def-sc-group-scheme] over a field k and let f:G\to H be a homomorphism. For every k-point a of G, translation by a carries the etale locus of f isomorphically to itself. Consequently the etale locus is empty or all of G, and f is etale if and only if it is etale at the identity.

source.place: Groupoid Schemes, lemma on etaleness of multiplication by d, proof using translations
